config_name: Razer Blade 16 — Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 / RTX 5090, 64GB RAM, 4TB SSD

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop 24GB GDDR7 (160W TGP)

battery.notes: Same 90Wh and platform as the reviewed config.

reviews.quote: With its thickness of barely 17 mm (~0.67 in) and weight of around 2 kg (~4.4 lb), the Blade 16 2025 is very mobile, and the quality of the case continues to be very high.

praises: MacBook-like rigid CNC aluminum unibody in a gaming laptop — 'the base unit cannot be warped' (NBC)
16-inch QHD+ 240Hz OLED superbly calibrated out of the box (DeltaE 1.2, 96.1% P3) with 0.2ms response
Under 2.1kg and 17.4mm with a full 160W RTX 5090 option — genuinely portable for the power
Two M.2-2280 SSD slots plus USB4, USB-A, HDMI and SDXC — no dongles needed
Improved 1.5mm-travel keyboard much better than older Blade models
complaints: Black anodized surfaces are extreme fingerprint and dirt magnets (NBC con: 'surfaces remain extremely susceptible to dirt')
RAM is soldered on the 2025 AMD model — NBC calls it 'a step backwards' for maintenance
High case temperatures under load; deck near the vents runs hot (NBC: 'case temperatures have increased')
OLED PWM flickering at 960Hz below 100% brightness bothers sensitive users
Long-standing Blade-line wear: anodizing/paint scuffs at lid edges and hinge corners over time

design_philosophy: Razer's Blade line is the 'MacBook of gaming laptops': a minimalist black CNC-machined aluminum unibody that hides serious gaming hardware with almost no visual noise. The 2025 Blade 16 pushed this further — 30% slimmer than its predecessor at barely 17mm, switching to efficient Ryzen AI silicon and a large vapor chamber to keep a 160W RTX 5090 in a 2.1kg chassis. This config sits in that philosophy as a premium thin-and-light gaming machine rather than a max-TGP brute.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the NBC-reviewed Blade 16 2025 RTX 5090 32GB config (87%): +0.5 productivity and +0.5 ai_ml for 64GB RAM (helps local LLMs/VMs). Soldered RAM makes the 64GB tier the effective ceiling.
standouts: 64GB soldered RAM + 24GB VRAM for local AI workloads
4TB from factory across two M.2 slots
dealbreakers: $6,300 CAD — near workstation money for a 12-core CPU
